component.name: Roomcast
component.summary: Play your computer's sound on HomePods, Sonos and other network speakers

description.p: Roomcast sends this computer's audio to AirPlay speakers such as HomePods and Sonos, and to Sendspin speakers such as the FutureProofHomes Satellite1.

ul.li: Group speakers into outputs that show up as ordinary sound devices
Make left/right stereo pairs from any two speakers, HomePods included
Send one app to your speakers while system sounds stay on the computer
Control it all from a menu in the top panel
